ns2:course.label: Communicating Public Policy
ns2:course.description: Study of the nature of policy-oriented communication; analysis and formulation of positions on issues of professional, personal, or public interest; design and presentation of public policy messages addressed to varying tasks and audiences, with special emphasis on advanced writing skills. Prerequisite: Completion of campus Composition I general education requirement.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: Completion of campus Composition I general education requirement.
ns2:course.sectionDegreeAttributes: Advanced Composition, and Grand Challenge-Sustainability course.
